configurePresets.name: pitchnet-dev
configurePresets.description: Side-by-side dev plugin identity, optimized so realtime behaviour in a DAW matches a release build while symbols are kept for the debugger. NOTE: these are Ninja presets, which inherit the target architecture from the environment - configure from Visual Studio or an x64 developer shell, never a plain prompt, or cl.exe silently targets x86.

configurePresets.name: pitchnet-dev-debug
configurePresets.description: Unoptimized dev build with asserts live. Use only for stepping through logic that RelWithDebInfo optimizes away - realtime performance in a DAW is not representative and dropouts here are not real bugs.

configurePresets.name: pitchnet-release
configurePresets.description: Shipping identity. This is the build that must keep resolving for projects saved against a released PitchNet.
